{{Quote|Well, we're just going to have to improvise. Get us a new scapedroid.|Voort saBinring|<ref name="MK">''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]''</ref>}}
'''Scapedroids''' were humanoid droids whose entire torso and head area was replaced by a large [[Holoprojector/Legends|holoprojectors]] or monitor. Nervous negotiators would send scapedroids to a parley site and speak to one another through the safe telepresence functions offered by the droids.<ref name="MK" />

In [[44 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]'' to [[44 ABY]].</ref> [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[Commando/Legends|commando]] unit [[Wraith Squadron]] rented one on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kuratooine]] during a mission.<ref name="MK" />
